description: This file defines functions and types for grouping and sharding test cases in the Playwright test runner, including logic for parallel execution, grouping by worker and require file, and sharding test groups across multiple shards.

methods.name: createTestGroups
methods.description: Groups test cases into test groups based on worker hash, require file, parallel mode, and hooks, considering expected parallelism.

methods.name: filterForShard
methods.description: Selects a subset of test groups for a specific shard based on total number of shards and current shard index.
